title: TelegramDonator
description: Telegram bot integration for donations and referral system.
body:
**Minecraft Paper/Spigot plugin with Telegram bot integration for donations via Telegram Stars and referral system.**

## Features

- ⭐ **Telegram Stars Payment**: Players can top up balance and buy donations using Telegram Stars (native Telegram payment system)
- 💰 **Donation System**: Players can buy donation packages through Telegram bot
- 👥 **Referral System**: Players can create referral codes and invite friends
- ⏱️ **Playtime Tracking**: Automatic tracking of referred players' playtime
- 🎁 **Rewards**: Configurable rewards for referrals and playtime milestones
- 🌍 **Multi-language Support**: Support for 6 languages (Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Polish)
- 💳 **Balance System**: Internal balance system for purchasing donations


## Requirements

- **Server**: Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- **Java**: Java 21+
- **Telegram Bot Token**: Get from [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather)
- **Internet Connection**: Required for Telegram API communication


## Commands
`/referral <code>`  `/ref`, `/refer`  `telegramdonator.use` (default: true)  Enter a referral code to get rewards

`/telegramdonator`  `/td`, `/tdonator`  `telegramdonator.admin` (default: op)  Main admin command 

`/telegramdonator reload`  -  `telegramdonator.admin`  Reload plugin configuration and language files 

`/telegramdonator setbalance <username> <amount>`  -  `telegramdonator.admin`  Set user's balance (in suns) 

`/telegramdonator help`  -  `telegramdonator.admin`  Show help message 



## Available languages:
- `ru` - Russian (Русский)
- `en` - English
- `de` - German (Deutsch)
- `fr` - French (Français)
- `es` - Spanish (Español)
- `pl` - Polish (Polski)
